# Relaxed QWERTY

> Documentation is being written. What is here is accurate; what is missing is coming.

Not to be confused with: a keyboard layout, a keyboard remapper, Dvorak or Colemak.

## Documentation

### What this is

What is Relaxed QWERTY?

Relaxed QWERTY is a free typing trainer that teaches the Relaxed QWERTY 1.0 method on an ordinary QWERTY keyboard: accuracy first, speed as a consequence.

https://keygrove-phi.vercel.app/docs/what-it-is/

### The method

What is the Relaxed QWERTY typing method?

Relaxed QWERTY keeps the standard QWERTY map and a stable finger-to-key relationship, but lets the hands move naturally instead of holding the rigid historical home-row posture — the bottom row in particular is reassigned (Z ring, X middle, C index, B right index).

https://keygrove-phi.vercel.app/docs/the-method/

### Your data

Where does Relaxed QWERTY store my progress?

Relaxed QWERTY stores your progress in your account; an account is free and needed to keep progress — without one, nothing is saved past the tab.

https://keygrove-phi.vercel.app/docs/your-data/

### Who makes this

Who makes Relaxed QWERTY?

Relaxed QWERTY is made by Strange Systems, the studio behind CropASAP and No Ceremony.

https://keygrove-phi.vercel.app/docs/who-makes-this/
